textbookBox.concept: Soni makes a cat mask by folding a paper in half, drawing half a cat, cutting along the line and opening it. The two sides are the same, so the mask is symmetrical.

beats.en: Soni makes a cat mask by folding a paper in half, drawing half a cat, cutting along the line and opening it. The two sides are the same, so the mask is symmetrical.
beats.speakEn: Soni makes a cat mask by folding a paper in half, drawing half a cat, cutting along the line and opening it. The two sides are the same, so the mask is symmetrical.

beats.en: Many things around us are symmetrical, such as a butterfly, a leaf, a kite and the letters A, H and M. Some things are not symmetrical, such as a hand, a shoe pair seen as one shoe, or the letter F.
